name: Cosme
insider_take: This stunning Cycladic retreat sits on Paros' dramatic coastline where ancient marble quarries once supplied stone for Venus de Milo and Napoleon's tomb.
whats_special: Cosme's infinity pool appears to merge with the Aegean Sea, while the hotel's design incorporates local Parian marble - the same prized white stone that Praxiteles used for his masterpieces. The property overlooks the legendary Parikia Bay, where Byzantine and Venetian influences still shape the charming port town below.
pro_tip: Book a sunset dinner on the terrace during the full moon - Paros offers some of the most spectacular moonrises in the Cyclades, best viewed from Cosme's elevated position.
dont_miss: A short walk to the 6th-century Panagia Ekatontapiliani, one of Greece's most important Byzantine monuments, and the nearby ancient marble quarries where you can still see unfinished sculptures abandoned by Roman craftsmen 2,000 years ago.
pros: Stunning clifftop location with panoramic Aegean Sea views
Authentic Cycladic architecture blending luxury with local heritage
World-class spa featuring traditional Greek wellness treatments
Exceptional dining with locally-sourced Mediterranean cuisine
cons: Remote location requires planning for off-property activities
Seasonal operation with limited availability outside summer months
